title: Rigging Field Guide
sub: Hardware, arena points and motors, bridle math, fly systems, truss and inspection — built to drill, not to read. Works offline.
description: Rigging for live events: shackles, steel and round slings, arena points and chain motors, bridle math, counterweight fly systems, truss, fall protection and inspection.
footer: Study and drill tool. It does not make anyone a qualified rigger — the head rigger, the venue and the engineer have the final word
